name: California Davis-Stirling Act

instruments.note: Corp. Code 7510-7512 (Nonprofit Mutual Benefit) also applies; read via california.public.law, retrieved 2026-10-23

calledBy.value: per bylaws; regular meeting required in director election years

noticeDays.note: 20 days min if non-first-class mail; election notices follow 30-day rule

noticeContent.value: place, date, time, remote means, matters board intends to present, known nominees

calledBy.value: board, chair, president, others per bylaws, or members holding 5%

value.onMemberRequest: meeting set 35-150 days after request for CID; notice within 20 days

noticeContent.value: general nature of business; no other business transacted

noticeDays.note: 2 days if executive session only; emergency exempt; longer governing-doc period prevails

noticeContent.value: time, place and agenda by general notice (4045); teleconference needs listed physical location

quorum.value: only if governing documents or law require; each ballot received counts toward quorum; Corp. Code default 1/3 of voting power

adjournedQuorum.value: director election lacking quorum: reconvene >=20 days later with 20% quorum (unless docs set lower); notice >=15 days. General adjournment max 45 days

ordinary.value: majority of voting power represented, entitled to vote, and voting (quorum present)

special.note: Amendment/assessment thresholds come from governing documents and other Civ. sections not fetched

value: per governing documents; cumulative voting only if documents provide, by secret ballot
weightageModels.note: Civ. 5115(e); voting power per election rules 5105

value.allowed: only if bylaws permit; cannot replace a ballot
value.form: voting instructions on separate detachable page; proxyholder votes by secret ballot; revocable before inspector receives ballot

value: secret ballot mandatory for director elections, recalls, amendments, certain assessments
electronic secret ballot (not for regular/special assessment votes)
votingMethods.note: Members may switch between electronic and written; 90-day freeze on rule amendments; ballots+rules >=30 days before

electronicVoting.note: Electronic secret ballots via election rules; identity authentication, receipt, separation from ballot, device test >=30 days before; vote irrevocable once transmitted

minutesDeadlineDays.note: board minutes (draft/final/summary) available within 30 days; election results to members within 15 days

value.inspectable: current + 2 prior fiscal years; meeting minutes permanent

memberInspectionRight.note: signed voter envelopes inspect only, not copy

value.inspector: 1 or 3 independent inspectors; not director, candidate, relatives, or paid contractor; may be a member
value.duties: authenticate proxies/ballots, count, decide challenges; report is prima facie evidence
value.custody: inspector holds ballots until challenge period (1 yr) ends

electionRoles.note: Public count at noticed meeting; results in minutes and general notice within 15 days

termYears.note: Seat must be elected when term expires and at least every 4 years; maximum terms per docs

eligibility.value: members at nomination; docs may bar nominees delinquent on assessments, <1 yr membership, co-owner on board, some convictions; cannot bar for unpaid fines/late charges
eligibility.note: Equal campaign access to media and meeting space

defaulterDisqualification.value: ballot cannot be denied except for non-membership; nominee disqualifiable for delinquent regular/special assessments (not fines/late charges; exceptions for payment under protest or plan)

notes: 2025 changes (AB 2159 electronic voting; AB 2460 reconvened-election quorum) confirmed only via secondary law-firm/legislative analyses; no confirmed 2026 election changes. Tie-break not found in 5105/5120/5125; set in election rules. Research only, not legal advice.

name: Florida HOA Act, Chapter 720

instruments.note: 2025 text via flsenate.gov; fetch tool summarised the text, spot-check against statute

noticeContent.value: date/time/place; purpose needed only for special

calledBy.value: board or, unless docs state different percentage, 10% of total voting interests

noticeDays.value: 48 hours posted (with agenda); 14 days for special assessments/rule amendments; 7 days if mailed instead of posted

noticeContent.value: agenda items; owners may speak 3 minutes

quorum.value: 30% of total voting interests unless bylaws set lower

adjournedQuorum.note: Adjournment to new date must be announced or noticed under 720.303(2); adjourned quorum not stated

ordinary.value: majority of voting interests present at a meeting with quorum

special.value: amendments: two-thirds of voting interests unless docs/law say otherwise; no adverse change to proportionate voting/share without owner joinder

directors.value: plurality; election only if nominees exceed vacancies

weightageModels.note: Not found in 720.306; per governing documents

value.form: dated, states meeting date/time/place, signed, revocable
value.expiry: effective only for that meeting; expires 90 days after meeting

value: secret ballot via inner/outer envelope if docs allow
votingMethods.note: duplicate ballots for same parcel disqualified; late ballots not counted

electronicVoting.note: Online voting if member consents, system authenticates identity, protects vote integrity, issues receipt, separates identity from secret ballots, device test >=14 days before; board resolution noticed 14 days; e-voters count for quorum

minutesDeadlineDays.note: no deadline found; minutes kept in writing with each director vote recorded (720.303(3))

memberInspectionRight.value: available within 10 business days of written request; min damages $50/day up to 10 days on willful noncompliance; 100+ parcels must have owner website portal since 1 Jan 2025

electionRoles.value: per governing documents; statute names no inspector; challenges within 60 days of results; disputes to arbitration or court

termYears.note: term limits not in 720.306; per bylaws

eligibility.value: all members unless delinquent at nomination deadline or certain felons (until 5 years after rights restored); director 90+ days delinquent deemed to abandon seat; director certification within 90 days of election

defaulterDisqualification.value: delinquent on any monetary obligation at nomination deadline cannot run or be listed on ballot

notes: HB 1203 (2024, ch. 2024-221) seen only as history note on 720.317 and website content in 720.303. 60-day election notice (720.306 / 720.307) not confirmed. Research only, not legal advice.

name: Texas Property Code Chapter 209

instruments.note: Tex. Bus. Orgs. Code fills gaps (not fetched); read via texas.public.law (third party)

calledBy.note: per bylaws; Bus. Orgs. Code not fetched

noticeDays.note: written notice of election or vote at a meeting

calledBy.value: regular or special; must be open to owners

noticeDays.value: posting: 144 hours regular, 72 hours special, plus email to registered owners; or mail 10-60 days

noticeContent.value: date, hour, place, general subject incl. executive session topics; electronic access instructions

quorum.note: Member quorum not in ch. 209 text read; absentee/electronic ballots count toward quorum only for items on ballot (209.00592(b))

proxy.value: association must allow absentee ballot or proxy

votingMethods.note: association need offer only one method beyond absentee/proxy unless documents say; in-person vote overrides earlier ballot; absentee/e-ballot not counted if motion amended

electronicVoting.note: Electronic ballot by email, fax or website; identity confirmable, receipt available; owners notified of online posting; counts as written signed ballot. Electronic owner meetings allowed per secondary source only

minutesDeadlineDays.note: board minutes kept, members may inspect (209.0051); no deadline

recordRetentionYears.note: associations with >14 lots must adopt retention policy

memberInspectionRight.value: written certified-mail request; respond by 10th business day (extendable to 15th with notice); cost policy required

electionRoles.value: tabulators may not be candidates or third-degree relatives; recount by qualified neutral person at owner cost; candidates may name one observer for secret ballot count

termYears.note: expired-term seat must be elected by owners (209.00593(a))

eligibility.value: restrictions on running void except residency (not all), no shared household with a board member, felony within 20 years

defaulterDisqualification.value: provision barring an owner from voting in board election or on matters affecting rights is void

notes: Votes outside a meeting need notice 20 days before ballot deadline (209.0056(a-1)). Associations over 100 lots must solicit candidates 10 days before ballots (209.00593). 2025 amendments not confirmed. Research only, not legal advice.
